Full search of a 10,000-picture database in under 100 ms
Up to 4 faces per channel at normal walking speed
Paired with AI IP cameras: 4 channels

notes: USB: rear panel 5 x USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A and 1 x USB 3.2 Gen2x2 Type-C; front panel 1 x USB 3.0.
